create_periodically_tf_op: create a tensorflow op that executes a body operation every N steps using the periodically function
run_periodic_tf_update: run a periodic tensorflow update op with a custom counter variable and specified period
test_periodic_no_op: test the periodically function returns a no_op when period is zero or None
review_periodic_body_validation: review the periodically function validates body is callable and period is non-negative
build_periodic_tf_counter: build a periodic tensorflow counter op that resets after reaching the specified period
